title: Windchill Quality - CAPA Hands On Workshop v.1
description: This is a hands-on workshop for the Corrective Action Preventive Action Process using the Windchill Quality Module. This workshop requires one cloud image per participant which needs to be set up in advance of the workshop. All participants will use the same login and user name and therefore they each require a stand-alone environment. The PTC Cloud Portal is recommended as there is already a template available for creating the required instances. The Windchill image that works with this workshop is: Windchill 11.1 M020 CPS08 v1.0 (TDD) - Windows based. This workshop includes an opening presentation and a detailed follow along script. The workshop is designed to be executed as a “Simon says” exercise. The Lead AE demonstrates the picks and clicks, explains what is being done and why and then, the participants will use their copy of the script to perform each process previously demonstrated. It is recommended the users print out the script to take notes as they walk through the process. Please be sure to clean up / delete any cloud instances used for this workshop once you have completed it.
source_item_id: sites/EXT-TDD/Demo Catalog/Windchill Quality - CAPA Hands On Workshop v.1
